# Donald Trump's job approval falls to 33%

August 11, 2026

results.content: Civiqs, which offers regular updates from its online surveys, pegged approval in Colorado of Trump’s job performance at 31%, with disapproval at 64% on July 30 (4% said they neither approved nor disapproved). [...] Drew Linzer, the director of Civiqs, previously told the USA TODAY Network the firm uses advanced and proprietary modeling to develop results from online surveys of around 200 to 250 registered voters daily across the country. Voters in Colorado and other states are represented in the sample "proportional to the sizes of those states in the US population." Those results are part of the process used in calculating Trump’s approval rating in each state.

President Donald Trump’s job approval rating in Alabama remains above water, though it has declined from the high point he reached at the start of his second term, according to the latest tracking data from Civiqs.

results.content:
Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 19, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. The survey has garnered 124,759 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term. [...] According to the Civiqs poll, Trump has the highest net approval rating in Wyoming, where 56 percent of voters approve of his performance and 35 disapprove—giving him a net approval rating of +22 when rounding up.

His net approval rating is also positive in several other states that make up the Republican heartland:
